# 10-year constant maturity nominal yields (monthly averages) from the data

# 1993 data
yields_1993 = {
    'Jan': 6.60, 'Feb': 6.26, 'Mar': 5.98, 'Apr': 5.97, 'May': 6.04, 'Jun': 5.96,
    'Jul': 5.81, 'Aug': 5.68, 'Sep': 5.36, 'Oct': 5.33, 'Nov': 5.72, 'Dec': 5.77
}

# 1998 data
yields_1998 = {
    'Jan': 5.54, 'Feb': 5.57, 'Mar': 5.65, 'Apr': 5.64, 'May': 5.65, 'Jun': 5.50,
    'Jul': 5.46, 'Aug': 5.34, 'Sep': 4.81, 'Oct': 4.53, 'Nov': 4.83, 'Dec': 4.65
}

# 2003 data
yields_2003 = {
    'Jan': 4.05, 'Feb': 3.90, 'Mar': 3.81, 'Apr': 3.96, 'May': 3.57, 'Jun': 3.33,
    'Jul': 3.98, 'Aug': 4.45, 'Sep': 4.27, 'Oct': 4.29, 'Nov': 4.30, 'Dec': 4.27
}

# Order of months
months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

# Combine all yields into one dictionary
all_yields = {}
for m in months:
    all_yields[f"1993-{m}"] = yields_1993[m]
    all_yields[f"1998-{m}"] = yields_1998[m]
    all_yields[f"2003-{m}"] = yields_2003[m]

# Calculate 3-month moving averages for March through December
# March average = (Jan + Feb + Mar) / 3
# April average = (Feb + Mar + Apr) / 3
# etc.

target_months = ['Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
moving_averages = []

for year in ['1993', '1998', '2003']:
    for target_month in target_months:
        idx = months.index(target_month)
        # Get 3 months ending at target_month
        m1 = months[idx - 2]  # 2 months before
        m2 = months[idx - 1]  # 1 month before
        m3 = months[idx]      # target month
        
        avg = (all_yields[f"{year}-{m1}"] + all_yields[f"{year}-{m2}"] + all_yields[f"{year}-{m3}"]) / 3
        moving_averages.append(avg)
        print(f"{year}-{target_month}: {m1}({all_yields[f'{year}-{m1}']}) + {m2}({all_yields[f'{year}-{m2}']}) + {m3}({all_yields[f'{year}-{m3}']}) = {avg:.4f}")

print("\n--- All Moving Averages ---")
for i, ma in enumerate(moving_averages):
    print(f"{ma:.2f}")

print(f"\nMin: {min(moving_averages):.2f}")
print(f"Max: {max(moving_averages):.2f}")
print(f"Range: {max(moving_averages) - min(moving_averages):.2f}")

    all_yields[f"2003-{m}"] = yields_2003[m]
